prompts.name: 01_inicio
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high fidelity desktop web app screen for MeloThing (spell exactly), a Portuguese musical learning platform with progressive learning paths, community-created courses, and AI musical tutor Melodia. Wide landscape 16:10 screen, front-facing flat screenshot, no device frame, no montage. Premium approachable learning product, generous whitespace, beautifully legible Portuguese labels, refined modern sans typography. Consistent design system: warm ivory #F7F3EC main background, charcoal #1B1A1E vertical left sidebar width about 200px, coral red #D84646 main accent, cream and pale rose surfaces, rounded 16px corners, subtle borders, tasteful small music-themed illustrations. Sidebar brand MeloThing with tiny waveform symbol, menu "Início", "Explorar trilhas", "Minha jornada", "Melodia", "Comunidade"; bottom "Meu perfil". Top right small study streak flame "3 dias" and "120 XP" and circular profile. Melodia MUST faithfully follow provided reference image: nonhuman red soundwave being, red ribbon sheet-music curls, dark red face with waveform eyes, classical black/red/ivory piano-key dress. Not a human girl, no skin, no ordinary hair, no age. Use original brand identity, do not copy Duolingo branding or owl. All displayed progress and user content are illustrative. Main UI readable, real product visual hierarchy, no huge gradients or glow, no decorative presentation board.
SCREEN 1: student home dashboard, sidebar Início active. Main heading "Seu próximo passo começa aqui." greeting "Olá, estudante". Dominant spacious pale rose horizontal welcome feature, left text "Vamos fazer música?" supporting "Continue sua jornada com a Melodia." coral action "Continuar aprendendo"; right large beautiful faithful Melodia full body illustration. Below elegant horizontal current course section with piano image "Piano do zero", "Etapa 3 de 12", modest progress 25%, link "Ver minha trilha". Bottom simple weekly study activity strip "Seu ritmo nesta semana" seven weekday circles with three completed. Right compact section "Meta de hoje" / "15 minutos de prática" and "Dica da Melodia" / "Um pouco por dia faz a diferença." Make this cohesive clean user dashboard.
